Name: Water Hose
Author: Willdan12
Description:
[center]
[b][size=6][color=#2ecc71]Water Hose[/color][/size][/b]
[size=4]A practical and automatic crop-watering mod for Stardew Valley![/size]
[/center]

[line]

[heading]📖 Description[/heading]
[b]Water Hose[/b] is designed to revolutionize your farming experience in Stardew Valley. Tired of constantly refilling your watering can or spending too much time watering crops one by one? This mod introduces a new item—the [b]Water Hose[/b]—that lets you water multiple crops at once simply by walking past them!

[heading]✨ Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Mass Watering:[/b] Just hold the hose and walk along your crop layout—no tapping or clicking required for each individual crop![/*]
[*][b]Infinite Water:[/b] No more running back and forth to a water source or well to refill.[/*]
[*][b]Balanced Stamina System:[/b] Using the hose consumes a small amount of stamina as you spray, keeping the gameplay balanced yet vastly more efficient.[/*]
[*][b]Crafting Recipe:[/b] Obtain the Water Hose recipe in-game to craft it yourself.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI Compatibility:[/b] Fully built and compatible with SMAPI versions (v4.0.0+).[/*]
[/list]
[heading]🛠️ Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Minimum version: [b]4.0.0[/b] or newer)[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (Latest version compatible with SMAPI)[/*]
[/list]
[heading]📥 Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] installed on your system.[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Water Hose[/b] mod file from this NexusMods page.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded zip file.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into the [b]Mods[/b] directory of your Stardew Valley game folder[/*]
[*]Launch your game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[heading]🙏 Shout Outs[/heading]
[list]
[*]Huge thanks to the [b]SMAPI[/b] development team for making Stardew Valley modding possible and seamless.[/*]
[*]Thank you to the Stardew Valley community for the incredible inspiration and support.[/*]
[*]And of course, thank you to you for downloading and trying out this mod![/*]
[/list]
[center]
[b]If you enjoy this mod, please don't forget to leave an Endorse 💚![/b]
[/center]
